title: LabscriptAI: benchmark artifacts and canonical implementation for manuscript Tables 1–2
description: Frozen benchmark artifacts and source code for reproducing manuscript Tables 1 and 2 (90-task Opentrons liquid-handling script generation benchmark). Includes cached authoring run shards, table builders, and the pure-Python LabscriptAI agent implementation (LabscriptAgentLoop authoring; RecoveryOrchestrator runtime) without LangGraph on the canonical reproduction path. See docs/reproducibility/manuscript_canonical_runbook.md for step-by-step instructions.
